title: solanum nigrum var. luteum
intro: Solanum nigrum var. luteum, commonly known as the Yellow Nightshade or Wild Eggplant, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Solanaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which can help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases like cancer and cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of Solanum nigrum var. luteum include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve digestion, and exhibit neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include solasodine, solasonine, and solamargine, which are glycoalkaloids responsible for its medicinal properties.
